name: BLE MIDI
description: The `ble_midi` component connects to a device that speaks MIDI over Bluetooth Low Energy — a wireless keyboard, a pad controller, a foot switch — and turns the notes, knobs and buttons it sends into automations. It can also send MIDI back to the device.

config_entries.label: BLE Client ID
config_entries.description: ID of the associated BLE client.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The ID to use for code generation, and for reference by the `ble_midi.*` actions.

config_entries.label: Max Sysex Size
config_entries.description: The size of the buffer used to reassemble System Exclusive messages, in bytes. Longer messages are truncated. Range: 8-2048. Defaults to `256`.

config_entries.label: Pair
config_entries.description: Pair with the device after connecting. Some devices refuse to send anything until they are paired. Defaults to `false`.
